config.executablePath: Absolute path to the pi-web server entry: a standalone server.js or the bin/pi-web.js inside the package. Leave empty for automatic resolution: built-in → global npm install → managed runtime.
config.package: Registry package name for managed/global install lookups — the pi-web-for-ide build with IDE integration patches (not upstream pi-web). The npm mirror is inherited from your npm config (`npm config get registry`).
config.workspaceRoot: Project directory (cwd) passed to pi-web sessions. Leave empty to use the current workspace folder.
config.sessionTabs: How clicking a session in the Sessions sidebar opens chat: perSession = each session gets its own tab (clicking again focuses it); single = reuse one panel, switching sessions inside it.
config.sessions.titleMaxWidth: Max session title width in the Sessions view, in visual columns (CJK/fullwidth chars count as 2). Longer titles truncate with an ellipsis so the trailing time and message count stay visible. 0 disables truncation. Full title remains in the hover tooltip.
config.sessions.metaLayout: How session meta (last-active time, message count) is displayed in the Sessions view: line = on a dimmed continuation row under the title (always fully visible, doubles row count); inline = appended after the title on the same row (compact, may clip on narrow views).
config.notifyAwaiting: Show a notification when a session finishes a turn and waits for input.
config.showOpenInBrowser: Show the Open in Browser button in the slim top bar of session tabs.
config.openBeside: Open the Pi for IDE panel in the adjacent column instead of the active one.
config.port: Preferred starting port for the Pi for IDE server (default 3030). If occupied, the next free port is used.
config.autoStart: Start the local pi-web server in the background when the extension activates (before the panel is first opened). Keep off if unused to avoid a resident process.
description: Pi for IDE — VSCode-native editor experience for pi coding agent. Full pi-web GUI (chat, sessions, model/MCP config, themes, etc.) plus deep VSCode integration: @ file mentions, context-menu mentions, active-file context, per-turn file review cards with inline diffs and one-click revert, clipboard bridge, etc.
config.autoStop: Let the extension-spawned pi-web server exit on its own after every window/client disconnects (server-side watchdog). The process then shuts down once no heartbeat or open page remains. Servers started standalone outside the IDE are never affected.
config.autoStopAfterSec: Seconds of full silence (no heartbeat, no open client) before an extension-spawned server exits. Applies only when autoStop is on. Minimum 90 — hidden browser tabs can only poll about once a minute.
config.checkForUpdates: Check once after activation for a newer pi-web-for-ide package and offer to upgrade (installSource decides whether the registry, the local tarball, or both is consulted).
config.localPackage: Path to a local pi-web .tgz — either the file itself or a directory containing packages (the newest matching build inside is picked automatically, so rebuilt artifacts keep being found even as filenames change).
config.installSource: Where installs/upgrades come from: auto = compare local tarball and registry, prefer the local build on a version tie; prefer-remote = same comparison but prefer the registry on a tie; local = only the localPackage tarball; registry = only npm (localPackage ignored).
viewWelcome.sessions: Pi sessions on this machine appear here, grouped by project. The server starts automatically when this view opens.
